reviews.x: I love the body wash especially the smell. Only reason I’m not giving 5 stars is picture is misleading and it did not come with a pump. I went back and did not see an option to select one or anything saying it didn’t come with one. So I have to pour it and I don’t like that.
I really wanted to like this product. Unfortunately I did not check the ingredients before buying.

I wanted to hate this, considering the price per ounce, but it's one of the best body washes I have ever used! It's a soft floral scent, with some creaminess, that reminds me of hugging my beautiful, classy, great aunt. Something about it reminds me of the early 2000s, I have no idea why, but it's a very comforting scent for me. My skin felt amazing after just one wash. So soft! I love the scent of Jasmine but wasn't sure about the Sandalwood and Rose scents but what a gorgeous surprise.  It's soft, powdery without bring too mature but mature- if that makes sense.  It's a sophisticate yet light scent. It's THAT good even though I have used it twice. I am super picky about smells and had to find a new body wash since the one I have used from Bath and Body Works wasn't manufactured for a few years. reviews.t: Santal Bloom: A powdery, feminine floral
reviews.x: Lovely aluminum packaging, a high-quality pump, super sudsy body wash. The Santal Bloom scent is a powdery floral—which is maybe not for everyone—but I love how the scent lingers softly and close to my skin, and how it layers with warm, cozy perfumes (Pinrose Secret Genius and Replica By the Fireplace, I’m looking at you!).

This body wash smells SO good. The sandalwood really comes through but it isn’t overpowering. I see some reviews say they did not receive the pump but I did and everything works. I will definitely be purchasing again and also the lotion!

Love form fist sight. I am the person who likes minimalistic design, interior and keep them throughput it everything. Everything need to be matchjng. So find this shower gel and it’s perfect decoration and product at the same time! Love the scent . And it looks amazing in shower. Love.
I liked this body wash so much that I ordered a travel size in every scent! The fragrance is just right and it leaves my skin feeling moisturized.

It’s amazing - it smells good, looks good, and makes me feel good. It gives a rich, expensive and luxurious feel and scent. I love feeling empowered after a good wash. It seems to make my skin softer. I just purchased about a week ago, so waiting to see how much it helps to clear dark marks. Overall, amazing buy.  The lather is better with a loofah, of course. Will be buying again.

reviews.t: Smells good! But it’s dented and scratched
reviews.x: This product smells great!  But as other reviews have stated, the bottle is not nearly full and it arrived with a big dent in the side. I still like it though!  I guess the dent doesn’t affect the product inside.

reviews.t: Super luxe look, smell and feel for a steal …AND eco friendly!
reviews.x: I bought this after hearing great reviews about the brand overall and especially this scent and the packaging — and it exceeded my expectations! The amount you get for the price is better than plenty of drugstore options too - and the bottle is chic enough to repurpose when I’m done. Can’t wait to try more scents!

reviews.t: Smells like a light version of le labo
reviews.x: If you’re into that hotel smell, you’ll like it. Light and not over powering. It’s a generous amount of product and the bottle looks cute in my shower.

This smells terrible!!! Based off the reviews, I was excited to try this. As soon as I opened the bottle I could tell this wasn’t for me. The scent is too strong and nothing like the description. Also, you have to PAY to return the item.

reviews.t: So Not filled anywhere close to the top.
reviews.x: [[VIDEOID:364fb1bb09c1e5709a3536618b192632]] I wanted to be 💯 in love with this product. Bummed it wasn’t filled more
I love the scent, I love the container! Lathers perfectly. Will be buying more.
Highly recommend, I'm buying all the fragrances!!

Didn’t expect to be so blown away by the scent (beige). Feel like I was transported to a sexy French side street in the evening or something. Cant speak to how it lathers etc because it is a gift. Of course need to be cautious since heavily fragranced skincare irritates some peoples skin, hopefully that doesn’t happen. The price was decent for what I’m assuming is a luxury soap, I got it for $9 on sale. However, for a luxury soap, the packaging needs to shape up!! The text was rubbing off, not a

I echo other reviewers' sentiments that it's not enjoyable to have a new product arrive looking like housekeeping forgot to replenish your toiletries and your using the last guests' stash. The bottle arrived only 2/3 full. Terrible first impression with too many other FULL body washes out there.

This smells like the soap you used to blow bubbles with as a kid. Very underwhelming. Idk if I’m missing something, but this was not what I was expecting. I see reviews raving about the scent on this .. did I get a different batch?  Other than the scent I actually really like it.

reviews.t: The reviews do not lie - Smells amazing!
reviews.x: I had read the positive reviews before and was hopeful but.... OH MY, I LOVE IT!!! When I opened it up for the first time in the shower, I instantly felt relaxed and happy. I can't describe the scent but it's so yummy, feminine and soothing. I can't imagine anyone not loving it.

This is probably the best smelling body wash I have ever used! Comes with a lot of product for the price as well, and the packaging is cute, functional, and looks great in my bathroom. Doesn't dry out my skin either. I will definitely be repurchasing this!
Cannot get enough of the smell, it fills my bathroom and smells lovely. I have sensitive skin and break out in hives from aveeno and other brands. Honestly just a round of applause for this brand
smells great. let’s be honest, i bought this mostly because i thought the cute packaging would look good in my shower. it arrived scratched with the wording coming off.
Bottle arrived half empty. Scent isn’t bad but it is VERY strong! I also expected a creamy consistency but it’s clear and hand soap type consistency.

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the Santal Bloom scent as lovely, soft, and feminine.
Some customers report the bottle arrived not full and/or dented or scratched.
A few reviewers mention the product did not come with a pump, though others received one that works.
Several reviewers describe the product as luxurious and good value for the price.
A small number of reviewers disliked the scent, finding it too strong or not as described.
